static_traits.name: Yang Kexin
static_traits.educational_background: High school graduate（目前在读大学，曾为照顾祖父母而退学，后复学）
static_traits.family_status: Living with parents and a young sibling
static_traits.social_status: 因数学压力与同学Relationship tension、协作受影响；有支持性家庭但not yet向家人充分透露困境
static_traits.medical_history: 既往without心理治疗/咨询经历；without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 语速平稳、表达清晰；能自我Reflection，配合度Good；情绪紧张、存在Self-denial和“应该”式陈述

basic_info.main_problem: I struggle with mathematics and feel I will most likely fail the course.
basic_info.core_demands: Because fear of failure in mathematics and persistent pressure affect overall physical and mental well-being and daily life, seeking support and guidance to relieve pressure and improve their state.
growth_experiences: 为照顾祖父母曾从大学退学，这是一次重大的生活转折；复学后感到与过去的自己脱节，认为High school阶段的成就仿佛是“另一个人的生活”。这一经历使其在大学Learning中更容易产生not适应与Self-doubt。
以往在数学方面一直有困难，但never像当前这样压倒性，这种长期学科弱项在进入更复杂内容后被显著放大，进而加重了失败Anticipation与Anxiety。
High school阶段成绩较好，形成“我应该继续保持优秀”的内在标准；在当前大学阶段without法达到过往水平时，倾向于将此Interpretation为“失败”，Reinforcement了Self-denial与Sense of frustration。

core_beliefs: I am not smart enough / not competent enough。

special_situations.event: Whenever facing math homework or exams
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能很快理解复杂的数学内容，就说明I am not smart enough，最终会挂科。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加倍Learning、向同学求助、use网络资源，在考场尝试深呼吸等以控制Anxiety。
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会挂科；I am not smart enough。

special_situations.event: When starting to answer questions in a major exam of the most difficult course
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在关键考试中表现not好，就证明我根本not适合大学Learning。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 考后自我批评、减少与他人互动，倾向于Withdrawal以避免进一步暴露not足。
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My mind is blank; I am bound to fail.

special_situations.event: 将当前大学表现与High school时期的高成绩进行比较时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果现在达not到以往的水平，就等同于失败，说明我not再优秀。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断自我比较与自我苛责，试图通过更用力Learning来“证明自己”。
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我现在not如从前，所以I am a failure。

special_situations.event: When cooperating with classmates to complete homework, needing collaborative communication
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我做得not够好，do not人一定会觉得我是拖后腿的。
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces interaction, avoids proactive cooperation to lower the risk of being evaluated.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会看not起我、觉得我是累赘。

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被看作有能力、能胜任大学学业并Gaining recognition与接纳。
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败、被negate与羞耻；担心暴露“not够聪明”的一面而被评价。
defense_goal: 通过过度用力Learning与理性化控制来减轻失败Anxiety
在高压场景中回避或Withdrawal以避免被评判与受挫

object_relations.object_representation: Picky classmates and teachers with high standards

object_relations.self_representation: not想让家人担心、强撑的孩子
object_relations.object_representation: 支持但可能not了解其真实困境的家人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited by the counselor to observe and record thoughts, or to discuss the theme of 'comparison and shoulds'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understands the counseling process as a task of needing to use rationality to 'collect evidence' to control the emotions, vaguely regarding the counselor as someone evaluating his ability
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气平稳、以分析与逻辑为主，频繁use“证据/理性”的词汇；当被邀请触及情绪时，转回对“应当如何做”的讨论。

manifestations: 因持续的失败Anticipation与Self-denial而与同学和老师Relationship tension，合作受影响
not yet向支持性的家人充分表达真实困境，感到与他人疏离
outcomes: 在学业与人际中Withdrawal，进一步固化“I am not good enough”的自我图式

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 反复以“我应该像High school一样表现更好”为内在标准评判自己
Demanding oneself with the rigid rule that failing a course equals failure

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: 将压力与not安转向自我苛责与Self-denial
在合作情境减少交流，出现Withdrawal甚至想再次退学的冲动

target_behavior.behavior: 在数学相关作业与考试前后的灾难化Anticipation与强烈Anxiety，并伴随Withdrawal/回避冲动（如想退学）
antecedent: Starting to learn more complex math content at the beginning of the term
target_behavior.core_reason: 长期数学弱项与对失败的灾难化Interpretation、与过往成绩的比较Reinforcement“I am not smart enough”的核心信念，trigger失败Anticipation与羞耻Fear
target_behavior.function: 短期内逃避被评价和失败带来的羞耻与Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Declining academic performance、整体成绩受影响；与同学Relationship tension；Sleep and appetite affected

target_behavior.behavior: 考试中出现大脑空白与注意力受损，伴随“I will fail”的自动化思维
antecedent: Entering a high-stakes exam for a difficult course
对自我能力与结果的负性Anticipation
target_behavior.core_reason: 强烈Anxiety与负性Automatic thoughts占用Work记忆，造成生理与认知的恶性循环
target_behavior.function: 在短期内降低面对困难题目时的心理负荷（not适应性反应）
target_behavior.consequence: Exam performance impaired, frustration intensifies, further consolidating failure beliefs
